build_ZoeDepthNK_model: build a ZoeDepthNK depth estimation model with a specified midas backbone and pretrained weights
build_ZoeDepthNK_from_config: build a ZoeDepthNK model from a configuration dictionary with all hyperparameters
run_ZoeDepthNK_forward: run forward pass on ZoeDepthNK model to predict metric depth and domain logits from an image
freeze_ZoeDepthNK_conf: freeze parameters for a specific bin configuration in the ZoeDepthNK model
get_ZoeDepthNK_lr_params: get learning rate parameter groups for ZoeDepthNK optimizer configuration with different lr factors
